name: Halo Wars 2: Forge Leader Pack
storyline: Sergeant John Forge: Skilled soldier, veteran leader, and born troublemaker. Forge bravely sacrificed himself to save his ship and his species during the events of the first Halo Wars, and now he’s back from the grave to show Atriox and the Banished how the Corps deals with alien troublemakers. Ooh-RAH!
summary: The Forge Leader Pack is a downloadable content (DLC) expansion for Halo Wars 2 that digitally resurrects Sergeant Major John Forge. While Forge remains canonically deceased in the main story of Halo Wars 2, this pack brings him back as a Multiplayer Leader. It allows players to command the UNSC forces using his unique military doctrine.
